name: Shophouse Parcel Drop Hatch
summary: Bilingual neighbourhood shopfront hatch with a native outward-opening panel and a stationary sample parcel.
description: Original SG/MY-inspired shopfront parcel hatch set in a limewashed bay with green tiled skirting. A local-only 3D demonstration opens the hinged flap to reveal a stationary fictional SAMPLE parcel. No parcel is accepted or sent.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Hand-authored original Blender stage with independently editable native parts, one sampled hinge animation and studio render. Material batches joined only for the GLB.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Original generic scene; not a real parcel drop, carrier, security device, vendor replica or certified infrastructure. Positive hinge motion is shown outward around local X. No communication, storage, data, payments, locking or actual logistics behavior.

attribution.credit: All model geometry, fictional signage, local animation and studio render authored for Blender-3D-Gallery. Blender bundled lettering converted to mesh; no outside textures, graphics or model assets.

interaction.note: Closed at start, opened in the poster. Parent shell and sample are stationary.
